Additional validation, accounting, and bounded-execution rules apply. Call path: DApp -> UserDashboard.getUserOverview/getCardHistory/getExitedCards -> MiningSystem.accountPositionCount.

closeAccelerationPermanently().details: Call path: owner -> MiningSystem.closeAccelerationPermanently; earnings calculation accelerationClosedAt .

configureCardComposer(address).details: Call path: deployment script -> MiningSystem.configureCardComposer; thenuser -> CardComposer.composeCard -> MiningSystem.consumeComposition.

consumeComposition(address,uint256,uint2.details: Call path: CardComposer.composeCard -> MiningSystem.consumeComposition -> MiningEarningsLedger.consume -> MiningEarningsSettlement.settleComposition -> RewardDistributor/NodeRewardPool.

consumeDynamicExitCapacity(address,uint2.details: Call path: RewardDistributorreward recording -> MiningSystem.consumeDynamicExitCapacity -> MiningSystem._exitPosition -> TeamPerformance/TeamEligibility.

importLegacyVirtualCards(address[],uint8.details: Call path: owner -> MiningSystem.importLegacyVirtualCards -> MiningSystem._createPosition; NFT.

onTeamLevelRefreshed(address,uint8).details: Call path: any caller -> TeamPerformance.refreshLevel -> MiningSystem.onTeamLevelRefreshed -> TeamEligibilityManager.updateEligibility.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

setFoundationWallet(address).details: Call path: owner -> MiningSystem.setFoundationWallet; then -> MiningSystem._payMintFee.

setMaturityDelay(uint256).details: Call path: owner -> MiningSystem.setMaturityDelay; thenuser -> MiningSystem.withdrawNormal -> MiningSystem.maturityDelay.

setWithdrawalExemptions(address[],bool).details: Call path: owner or configuration script -> MiningSystem.setWithdrawalExemptions; thenMiningSystem.withdrawNormal Additional validation, accounting, and bounded-execution rules apply.

stakeAcceleration(uint256,uint256).details: Call path: user -> MiningSystem.stakeAcceleration -> PriceOracle.quoteMobToUsdt -> MÖB.transferFrom(user,).

upgradeAcceleration(uint256,uint256).details: Call path: user -> MiningSystem.upgradeAcceleration -> PriceOracle.quoteMobToUsdt -> MÖB.transferFrom(user,).

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

withdrawImmediate(uint256).details: Call path: user -> MiningSystem.withdrawImmediate -> MiningEarningsLedger.consume -> MiningEarningsSettlement.settleWithdrawal -> RewardDistributor/NodeRewardPool/InteractionPool.

withdrawNormal(uint256).details: Call path: user -> MiningSystem.withdrawNormal -> MiningEarningsLedger.consume -> MiningEarningsSettlement.settleWithdrawal -> RewardDistributor/NodeRewardPool/InteractionPool.

consumeComposition(address,uint256,uint2.notice: Consumes produced and unconsumed static earnings from one position for card composition.

miningCardTypeStats(uint8).notice: Returns global working and exited counts for one mining card type, split between NFT and virtual cards.

positionConsumedTotals(uint256).notice: Returns the historical base and acceleration USDT values consumed by withdrawals or composition.

withdrawImmediate(uint256).notice: Withdraws all currently produced and unconsumed static earnings for one position with a 20% MÖB fee.

withdrawNormal(uint256).notice: Withdraws matured and unconsumed static earnings for one position without an NCN check or fee.
